title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials
slides: Isomorphic Labs just raised $5B — but can it deliver?
The AI drug discovery firm spins out of DeepMind's AlphaFold work
Most AI-designed drugs still fail before reaching patients
Your next treatment may be designed by an algorithm, not a chemist
Watch for its first clinical trial candidate this year
thread_text:
1. $5B Bet On AI Drugs

Isomorphic Labs just raised $5 billion to design drugs with AI. Its first clinical trial candidate is expected this year — a make-or-break moment for the entire field.

2. The AlphaFold Advantage

Spun out of DeepMind, the company builds on AlphaFold's protein-structure breakthrough. That gives it a huge head start in predicting how potential drugs will bind to targets.

3. The 90% Failure Problem

Most AI-designed drugs still fail before reaching patients. That's the brutal reality behind the hype — and the reason this $5B round is being watched so closely.

4. Your Next Treatment?

The algorithm won't replace chemists, but it may soon design your next prescription. If Isomorphic delivers, the way medicines are discovered changes forever.

5. Watch This Trial

If you follow AI in health, watch for Isomorphic's first clinical trial candidate this year. That single announcement will tell you whether the $5B was genius or hype.
